title: Silk Road Crossing: Tashkent, Samarkand and Almaty
alt: Tiled madrasah facades on the Registan in Samarkand
transport: Private transfers, guided walking tours and two internal flights

stops.subtitle: Tashkent → Khujand

program.name: Tashkent

stops.name: Samarkand
stops.subtitle: Samarkand → the Seven Lakes

activities.description: The tiled madrasahs of the Registan, the Bibi Khanym mosque, the Shah i Zinda tombs and the Gur e Amir mausoleum.

activities.name: Seven Lakes of Tajikistan
activities.description: A day into the Fann mountains along the chain of seven coloured lakes, from Nezhigon up to Hazorchashma.

program.name: Samarkand
program.description: Two nights at the heart of the old Silk Road, with the Registan and a mountain day along the Seven Lakes.

stops.name: Tashkent

program.name: Tashkent
program.description: A night back in the capital with the day free before the flight north onto the Kazakh steppe.

stops.name: Astana
stops.subtitle: Astana → Burabay

activities.name: Astana sightseeing tour

activities.name: Burabay National Park
activities.description: Pine forest, granite outcrops and clear lakes a few hours north, the stretch of country Kazakhs call their Switzerland.

program.name: Astana
program.description: Two nights in the new Kazakh capital with its landmark towers and a day out in the lakes and pines of Burabay.

stops.name: Almaty
stops.subtitle: Almaty → Charyn Canyon

activities.name: Almaty city sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided tour of the old capital, taking in the Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral.

activities.name: Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort
activities.match: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
activities.description: A day up the Malaya Almatinka valley to the Olympic skating rink at Medeu, then by gondola to the Shymbulak slopes.

activities.name: Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake
activities.match: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake From Almaty

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Three nights to finish in the old capital, with the city tour, the Shymbulak gondola and a day at Charyn Canyon.

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: Three countries in ten nights and still only two internal flights. The Registan and the Charyn Canyon in the same trip is a rare combination.
expert.tip: Carry your passport everywhere on days two and four. Both of those run across the Tajik border and back in a single day.

summary: Eleven days along the old Silk Road and out onto the steppe: Tashkent and a border day in Khujand, the tiled Registan at Samarkand and the Seven Lakes, then Astana with Burabay and Almaty with Shymbulak and Charyn Canyon.
included: Included: 10 nights with daily breakfast across Tashkent, Samarkand, Astana and Almaty; private airport transfers; Tashkent walking tour; day trip to Khujand in Tajikistan; a guided historic walking tour of Samarkand; the Seven Lakes tour in Tajikistan; Astana sightseeing tour; Burabay National Park trip; Almaty city sightseeing tour; Medeu and Shymbulak day trip; Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake day trip.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the two internal flights; Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and Kazakhstan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
